title: ShajjraMemberNode
description: Standardized genealogical node for Shajjra lineage graphs and tree visualization.

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID or sequential slug) for the family member.

name.description: Full formal name including customary titles or honorifics.

nickname.description: Kunya, familiar title, or colloquial name.

parent_id.description: Primary branch parent ID for single-parent tree traversal.

birth_order.description: Sequential sibling birth order (1 for firstborn).

generation.description: Generation tier counted from root patriarch (e.g., 1 to 45).

yob.description: Year of birth (approximate or historical CE).

text_color.description: Hex text color code for branch badge.

bg_color.description: Hex background color code for branch lineage group.

profile_url.description: Canonical URL on shajjra.com for full biography.
